spans.text: A battered truck comes to a halt within the quiet forest.
From a distance, all that can be seen is the edge of a torn white cloak poking out from a shattered window.
The Paradeus forces have streamed into the forest and surrounded the truck, but they do not approach.
Scouts, send out a team to investigate the interior of the truck.
All other units, continue forward and find the target.
A team of scouts cautiously approach the truck while the rest of the Paradeus forces search for tracks...
Look carefully and check if this truck is a trap. Let's see what tricks a mere human can pull...
The scouts flank the truck from various angles...
Boom!
As the scouts approach, the abandoned truck explodes and takes out the nearby Paradeus forces.
Humans will be humans. I can't believe they used such a clichéd trap. The Griffin Commander is taking us too lightly.
Turning her back to the explosion, the petite girl studies the messy tracks on the ground coldly.
Hehe, you've hidden your trail pretty well, but it's pointless...
After all, you'll fall into my hands in the end! ♪
Boom! The sound of an explosion comes from the distance.
I wish I were there to see them get blown up...
I saw everything Paradeus just did through the camera we left in the truck.
The way they surrounded the truck is a telltale sign that there's a high-level commanding unit nearby...
Commander...
I know. A high-ranking leader is directing them.
So basically, we've got a Paradeus unit on Nimogen's level following us?
That would be troublesome. None of the high-level Paradeus commanding units we've encountered so far were beaten by conventional methods.
Don't slow down. Carry on.
Machlian remains asleep on my back. Right now, I'm actually starting to envy her.
I can hear their footsteps!
Dammit, they sure run fast.
Commander, we're almost in Paradeus' firing range!
We can't shake them at this range. Why don't we make the first move?
Prepare for battle.
Right now, our aim is to break out of this while staying alive.
Got it!
